title: Which Swim Meet Will Be the Fastest This Year? Fans Have a Clear Favorite!
summary: Imagine you're picking the fastest roller coaster at a theme park. That's kind of what swimming fans just did! SwimSwam asked readers: which big swim meet this year will have the fastest winning times? The choices were the Commonwealth Games, Pan Pacific Championships (Pan Pacs), European Championships, and Asian Games. The winner, with a huge 59.8% of votes, was Pan Pacs! Why? Let's dive in. This year is special because there's no Olympics or World Championships. So the best swimmers are spread out at different meets. Pan Pacs brings together stars from the USA, Australia, Canada, and other Pacific countries. And on the women's side, they're super strong. Last year, 14 out of 17 individual gold medals at Worlds went to women from Pan Pac countries. This season, 12 of the 17 top-ranked women are from those countries too. The biggest reason might be Summer McIntosh. She's the most dominant female swimmer right now, and she's only racing at Pan Pacs—not the Commonwealth Games. On the men's side, it's closer. European swimmers hold more world-leading times, but Pan Pacs has some fast guys like Sam Short. So, if you want to see the fastest splashes, keep your eyes on Pan Pacs this summer!
why_it_matters: This shows how different sports events can become more exciting when the biggest competition is missing, just like a school field day where some events might have surprise winners because the fastest kid is in a different race.

background_read: SwimSwam is a website where swimming fans get the latest news and vote on fun questions.
The Pan Pacific Championships, or Pan Pacs, is a swim meet held every four years featuring top swimmers from Pacific Ocean countries like the USA, Australia, and Canada.
Summer McIntosh, a Canadian teenager, is one of the world's best swimmers, having won gold at the Olympics and World Championships.
Because there is no World Championships or Olympics in 2025, the other big meets like Pan Pacs and the Commonwealth Games become extra important.
Article_Structure: WHO: Swimming fans and SwimSwam readers, along with elite swimmers like Summer McIntosh, Sam Short, and others.
WHAT: A poll asking which 2025 swim meet will have the fastest times, with Pan Pacs winning easily.
WHERE: The poll was conducted on the SwimSwam website, an online swimming news site.
WHY: Because the absence of the Olympics and World Championships means top swimmers are split among several meets, and Pan Pacs has a concentration of the best women, especially Summer McIntosh.

perspectives.description: Fans of Pan Pac countries are thrilled because they get to see a star-filled meet with many Olympic champions.
